title: j-zulick/crossvet
summary: One chat, any model: use Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok or a local model from Hermes, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex or a terminal, and pick the model yourself. Costs shown and capped. OpenAI-compatible server and MCP tools.

title: ofcRS/kleoth
summary: Local-first macOS app: Wispr Flow-style dictation, bot-free meeting recording and Loom-style screen recording. Meetings transcribed on device with Whisper; bring your own AI (Claude Code, Codex, Ollama, OpenRouter); files you own.

title: deziss/llm-secure-gateway
summary: Self-hosted, multi-tenant LLM gateway: scoped virtual API keys, RBAC, cross-provider failover, PII scrubbing, spend governance and OpenTelemetry tracing for Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and Groq. OpenAI- and Ollama-compatible. Runs fully air-gapped.

title: abdelatifel/variant-rag-assistant
summary: Retrieval-grounded LLM summaries for genetic variant interpretation (ClinVar, PubMed, gnomAD) with a local LLM

title: dawidolko/MarketingCreator-LLM-Python
summary: Marketing copy from a local LLM (Ollama, Qwen 2.5 7B): ad headlines, slogans, product descriptions and social posts in Polish and English, copy written from a product photo (gemma3), batch catalogues and campaigns with automatic quality checks. Gradio, Typer CLI, Docker. Team project for an LLM course.

title: Mostafa-Kamel-Elsoudy/baremetal-llm-watchdog
summary: Lightweight Linux systemd daemon in Python/Bash for bare-metal CPU/RAM/disk, host/GPU thermal monitoring, and local LLM (Ollama/vLLM) inference health probing with Slack webhook alerting.

title: ianalexga15-hash/astrolabio
summary: Agente de trading autónomo para MEXC en modo Paper: modelo propio entrenado en GPU T4, LLM local con Ollama y controles de riesgo deterministas.

title: luoyuda123/PromptPersona
summary: Answer 12 questions once and get a reusable AI persona + system prompt. 10 UI languages incl. Arabic RTL, any OpenAI-compatible model, 3 strategies, fully offline, zero dependencies (Python + Tkinter).

title: Dragonswithin/happy-bot-kde
summary: Happy Bot: an AI search bar for the KDE Plasma 6 panel. Type anything and it finds files, answers from the web, and acts on your desktop through tools (MCP), with any local or hosted LLM.

title: PerDiemInc/gantrix
summary: Open-source, local-first AI agent orchestrator. A planner splits goals into dependent steps, agents with SKILL.md + MCP skills run them in parallel on Ollama, and a judge checks each result. LangGraph.js + BullMQ.

title: ashlrai/phantom
summary: Chasing open-source RSI (recursive self-improvement): a fully autonomous software factory that improves itself. Anyone can join Phantom with their own agents and compute: Claude Code, Codex, Devin, Grok and local models.

title: aisixteen/fantastic
summary: A medium that unifies humans and AIs into a single workspace: a kernel where models, programs, files, shells and a live canvas are all agents, reached by one call.

title: Proffware/MASS-PORTAL
summary: Manage your computers' system stats, open windows, files, and terminal directly from your Android phone over your local network. It also connects to external AI models (via Ollama) on your machine so you can control your PCs using plain text commands.

title: riveoca/tareas
summary: App web local que usa IA (Claude u Ollama) para convertir el trabajo del equipo en tareas de Jira y seguir el avance del sprint.

title: NullAITech/azoth-local-agent
summary: Archon Orchestrator core agent for local zero-telemetry task dispatching and subagent delegation.

title: MdMuzammilNihal/FixLoop
summary: Local AI coding assistant that analyzes, fixes, optimizes and runs code with Ollama. Fixes are verified and retried with the error as feedback. FastAPI + React.

title: arjunprakash027/tabtrail
summary: Turn your browser history and AI chats into a local map of your interests

title: girish503/emerald-agent-fabric
summary: Governed runtime + evals harness for AI coding agents — fail-closed verification, bounded repair, and honest benchmarks.

title: OnkelTheorie/schneidi
summary: Fast, light open-source video editor you can edit with an AI – chat in the app (Claude, OpenAI-compatible, Ollama), MCP server and CLI, offline subtitles. Linux AppImage/.deb.
